# GitHub configuration

- `workflows/c-cpp.yml`: the continuous integration workflow. It builds and runs the tests on
  Ubuntu (GCC 11 and 14, Clang 18) and macOS. See
  [../docs/architecture/build-and-tests.md](../docs/architecture/build-and-tests.md).
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`: templates for bug reports (`bug_report.md`) and feature requests
  (`feature_request.md`).
